criteria.definition: The applicant describes a concrete technical work example or a permitted description of private work, with enough detail to understand what was built or solved. A public link is optional; this is a statement-completeness criterion, not an independent certification of competence.
The applicant explains what they personally did in that example. A clear first-person account meets this criterion; do not claim that authorship has been independently proved.

The applicant states a specific technical skill, project or practice goal they want to pursue in the community. Prestige, credentials, employer, nationality and personal background are not admission requirements.
